evidence_loop.label: three readers that answered for a state they never measured
evidence_loop.summary: Three runtime readers reported a state they had not determined. compatNextSteps carried no `current` branch, so a drift-free compat run fell to the fail-closed fallback and every default doctor run told the operator to upgrade the runtime — a regression from aaf4744, first shipped in plugin-runtime-v0.90.2, which replaced a trailing `return []` that had served `current` only by accident. nextStepsForPlan and buildRecommendedSequence enumerated two blocked statuses and handed everything else generic implementation guidance, so an informational standing-watch plan was told to start compatibility work and a blocked_baseline_unusable plan was recommended a refresh the tests say cannot repair it. parseCodexPluginList mapped every non-ENOENT failure to `unsupported`, discarding the blocked/ETIMEDOUT classification commandStatus had already made. A fourth subtask would have refreshed the host-parity baseline; the owner deferred it because ADR-0060 removes the baseline, runtime:compat and the drift gate outright.

feature_commits.note: Adds an explicit `current` branch to compatNextSteps (plugins/runtime/scripts/lib/state-readers.mjs) so a drift-free compat run is no longer told to upgrade the runtime. Mutation-verified by restoring the aaf4744 fallback.

Stops parseCodexPluginList collapsing every non-ENOENT failure into `unsupported`, keeping the COMMAND outcome (status, error_code, exit_code) and the PARSE outcome of a successful command distinct, and amends ADR-0034 Decision item 2 in place. Mutation-verified by restoring the collapse.

Gives every plan status nextStepsForPlan writes an explicit answer and makes buildRecommendedSequence look at terminal plans (plugins/runtime/scripts/compat.mjs), then makes the fallback fail closed. Mutation-verified by restoring the two-branch fallback and the terminal-blind sequence.

install_method: Neither host was mutated: the install predated this recovery. Claude installed_plugins.json resolved runtime@agentic-plugins to 0.97.3 at 2026-09-18T01:54:31Z (gitCommitSha ea4b0e2); Codex served tree held 0.97.3 as its only runtime version. No session ran a Codex install or upgrade command and no plugin-management artifact backs it, so the Codex mechanism is inferred, as for 0.97.2.
narrative: Delivery was measured twice, because a tree digest cannot show WHICH fix arrived. diff -r between Claude cache and Codex served tree, excluding the .orphaned_at supersede marker, reports no difference at 120 files each, whole-tree digest 892c35621e11559933d72c3ce632d4b805d27aa07a46b030e7796c66e1b4ff51 under the scorecard path-first recipe with its locale — published only after that implementation reproduced BOTH retained caches published digests, 0.97.1 3f338a25 and 0.97.2 ee5ae232, from disk as controls. Per file: all 7 files this release changed blob-compare equal against the release tag on both hosts, covering state-readers.mjs (C9), machine-probe.mjs (C11), compat.mjs (C13) and doctor.mjs (C9 and C11). The packaged baseline hash is unmoved and validate:release-obligation reads fulfilled. TWO OF THE THREE FIXES ARE NOT EXERCISED BY THIS RUN AND ARE NOT CLAIMED FROM IT. C9 `current` branch and C13 informational-plan branch are reachable only from a `current` compat run, which a stale baseline cannot produce; C11 is not exercised unless the list probe fails. The report carries zero occurrences of C9 defect text, and that proves nothing: the C9 commit adds exactly `if (status === current) return [];` and touches no other branch, so the text is absent because this run is release_notes_required. By owner decision on 2026-09-18 all three are evidenced by their tests plus the per-file delivery measurement above. THE PARITY DROP FROM READY 100% TO BLOCKED 87% IS A REVEAL, NOT A REGRESSION, AND THE PRIOR ARTIFACT SAYS SO. doctor-20260912T224114Z-477c02 recorded ready 100% 8/8 with compat drift none and both hosts matches — but the compat run it read was compat-20260828T090343Z-1ee918 from 2026-08-28, whose observed versions were frozen at 2.1.250 / 0.150.1, the pair seen on that date. That 100% was computed over a fifteen-day-old artifact and the drift it hid had already accumulated. This loop fresh snapshot observed the real pair, 2.1.276 / 0.155.0, and reports release_notes_required. Closing the one blocked criterion means ingesting release notes and refreshing the baseline, which is the deferred BL work and whose subject ADR-0060 deletes; issue #388 therefore stays open and is closed by that removal rather than by re-observation. The owner re-reviewed Codex /hooks and the loop recorded settings-20260918T040649Z-9365d7 binding codex 0.155.0; the CLI move from 0.154.0 alone opened that gate, since runtime ships no hooks and the four bound plugin versions (designer 0.3.7, engineer 0.21.8, founder 0.4.7, orchestrator 0.13.5) were unchanged.

relations.note: The preceding runtime loop, and this loop control: its ready 100% was read over a compat artifact fifteen days old, which is how the drop to 87% was established as a reveal, not a regression. Its record noted the compat next-step reader gap and left it unfixed; C9 is that fix.
